regime.description: Which contract this prefix is checked against; selects which checks run

author.description: Writer named in the commit message; never written to package metadata

contributor.description: Navigational turn-filename label (spec:protocol/occurrence.md 5); carries no provenance authority

workflow.description: Workflow id every revision must be stamped with

package_schema_path.description: Logical key at which the package vendors the registered workflow schema

vendored_schema.description: Our copy of the registered schema, resolved inside policies/

watchlist.description: Regexes for artifacts whose undeclared size decrease is a defect

decrease_markers.description: Stems that count as declaring a reduction when in the same sentence as the file

float_ok_packages.description: Packages the protocol permits citing unpinned; every other cross-package citation must be revision-pinned

pre_migration.description: Retired-regime tunables, read only by pre-migration-regime checks. Not live config.

structured_file_fields.description: Retired user_meta fields naming files, mapped to the diff part their claims had to land in
